description:
1. Goods Receiving & Shipping
* Manually load, unload, and transport goods using support tools (e.g., hand truck) as part of manual handling tasks.
* Receive goods, organize goods in the warehouse, ship goods, and inspect goods upon arrival or at supplier/customer sites in special cases.
2. Warehouse Management
* Monitor and manage warehouse stock levels (basic inventory control).
* _Operate internal system MISA or Excel to manage stock in/ out and inventory.
3. Packing & Documentation
* Pack goods for delivery, prepare goods (including items sorted or divided according to orders or customer requirements), and affix packing labels when necessary.
* Create and issue Delivery Notes (DN), collect signed DN (hardcopy or image), and ensure proper filing and record retention.
* Weigh and measure goods to support completing customs clearance procedures.
4. Pick-up & Delivery
* Pick up or deliver goods/documents from suppliers or to customer warehouses in urgent or special cases.
* Conduct joint inspection of goods with customers when required.
5. Shipment Coordination
* Arrange suitable shipments for delivery and pick-up of goods by coordinating with suppliers, customers, shipping companies/drivers, and related parties.
* Monitor delivery progress and proactively handle any delivery issues (e.g., delays, incorrect items, urgent requests).
* Track and perform periodic reconciliation of freight-related accounts payable and arrange payment to service providers.
6. Additional Tasks
* Perform other tasks as needed to support the team’s objectives.
requirements_text:
1. Educational Background & Experience:
* Graduated from college or higher in related fields and have at least 3 years of experience in logistics, delivery coordination, or warehouse operations.
2. Skills:
* Basic understanding of warehouse and inventory processes
* Ability to use Microsoft Excel and basic data entry tools
* Good communication and coordination skills (internal & external)
* Problem-solving mindset, especially in time-sensitive situations
3. Personality Traits
* Responsible, Reliable and detail-oriented
* Hands-on and proactive attitude
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
4. Others
* Willing to work at warehouses (within Hanoi or nearby provinces)
* Willing to travel to industrial zones for deliveries or pickups
Kiến thức ngành
Logistic / Vận tải, Kho vận
Kỹ năng cần có
Problem-solving, Microsoft Excel, Communication and coordination, Warehouse and inventory processes
